user: You can now silence wikiman in any project without losing its wiki: /wiki:disconnect pauses context injection, staleness prompts, and auto-recap while keeping docs/wiki/ on disk; /wiki:reconnect turns it back on.
what: Added /wiki:disconnect and /wiki:reconnect commands. Disconnect stops context injection, staleness checks/prompts, end-of-turn recap, /wiki:update, and /wiki:init for that folder; the docs/wiki/ bundle stays untouched, the viewer and lookup tools keep working. Reconnect resumes everything.
why: Some projects don't want a live wiki nagging (archives, vendored code, short experiments) but deleting the bundle loses accumulated knowledge — disconnect/reconnect separates "stop being proactive" from "remove the wiki".
next: Run /wiki:disconnect in a folder you want quiet, /wiki:reconnect to resume. New commands need a fresh session or /reload to appear.
summary: Added DISCONNECTED_FILE registry (~/.pi/agent/.wiki-disconnected.json, mirrors omitted-registry pattern) with load/save/isDisconnected helpers; guards in session_start (footer 'wiki: disconnected', skips init-ask + staleness), before_agent_start (no injection), agent_end (no recap, pending timer cancelled), /wiki:update and /wiki:init (refuse with hint). /wiki viewer and wiki_* tools remain usable. Type-check: 21 pre-existing errors before and after — zero new.

user: wikiman now works fully self-contained: the end-of-turn recap runs in-process (no agentman, no prompt copying — just install and it records learnings/decisions/rules), and re-running /wiki:init can no longer destroy your authored overview/glossary content.
what: R1: the end-of-turn recap is now a single in-process model call with deterministic JSON→note writing through the same funnel as the wiki_note_* tools — no intelligent-delegation dependency, no agent prompts to copy. F1: /wiki:init on an existing bundle now only adds missing scaffold files (authored overview/glossary/concepts are never overwritten; last_updated is never reset). Curator: without agentman installed, /wiki:update and staleness prompts fall back to an in-session update instead of silently doing nothing.
why: Closes the handover's top roadmap item: the flagship recap feature was conditional on a sibling package; now a clean install records notes end-to-end. Closes a real data-loss bug found in review.
next: Test in a fresh session: make a turn with a clear learning and watch the recap record it without agentman installed; also try /wiki:init on an existing bundle to confirm nothing is overwritten.
summary: R1: replaced spawnRecap/spawnWikiAgent recap path with runInlineRecap — RECAP_PROMPT const, parseRecapNotes (fence/prose-tolerant JSON extraction, unknown types dropped), completeOnce via modelRegistry.complete + AbortSignal.timeout(45s) + randomUUID sessionId, 2-attempt retry, per-note try/catch, silent skip when model/auth absent, .catch on the debounced timer (session-kill guard). agent_end captures model/modelRegistry synchronously. Curator: spawnWikiAgent gained fallbackSteer — agentman/agent missing now falls back to an in-session update via curatorFallbackPrompt steer; staleness delegationPrompt adapts to delegate-tool absence. F1: initBundle is ensure-semantics (writeIfMissing with BufferEncoding passthrough, hadAuthored gates the auto-doc LLM pass, last_updated.md never reset), /wiki:init confirm + notify text updated. tsc: 21 errors = exact pre-existing baseline, 0 new. agents/wiki-recap.md kept as legacy copy.
